31class PlayResultProcessorComponent extends Component
32{
33    //Process a play result submitted via AJAX. Takes explicit values, no cookies.
34    //$seconds: Time spent on the problem, in seconds.
35    //$setConnectionID: Part of the set the problem is played from; null means
36    //the display set connection is deduced instead.
37    //$pageMode: Mode of the page the problem was played on, see playMode(); null means the stored mode.
38    //Returns result with xp_gained, new_rating, new_xp, new_level, new_damage, status,
39    //potion_triggered and achievement_updates, and in the mistake training
40    //mistake_training_button.
41    public function processResult(int $tsumegoID, PlayOutcome $outcome, float $seconds, ?int $setConnectionID = null, ?int $pageMode = null): array
42    {
43        Auth::overrideMode($this->playMode($tsumegoID, $pageMode));
44        try
45        {
46            return $this->processResultInPlayMode($tsumegoID, $outcome, $seconds, $setConnectionID);
47        }
48        finally
49        {
50            Auth::overrideMode(null);
51        }
52    }
53
54    //The mode a result counts in, when it is not the stored one. The mode is stored on
55    //the player, and opening another mode in another tab, or going back to a page in
56    //the browser history, switches it under a page that is still open, so the page says
57    //which mode it was played in. A page of the training counts as training only while
58    //the problem is in today's training, so claiming it spares no hearts on any other
59    //problem. A page of a normal mode counts in its own mode when the stored one is the
60    //training, which is what the other tab switched to. Any other disagreement keeps
61    //the stored mode.
62    private function playMode(int $tsumegoID, ?int $pageMode): ?int
63    {
64        $storedMode = Auth::getMode();
65        if ($pageMode === null || $pageMode === $storedMode)
66            return null;
67
68        if ($pageMode === Constants::$MISTAKE_TRAINING_MODE)
69        {
70            $row = MistakeTraining::getPoolRow((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
71            return $row !== null && MistakeTraining::isInTodaysTraining($row) ? $pageMode : null;
72        }
73
74        $normalModes = [Constants::$LEVEL_MODE, Constants::$RATING_MODE, Constants::$TIME_MODE];
75        if ($storedMode === Constants::$MISTAKE_TRAINING_MODE && in_array($pageMode, $normalModes, true))
76            return $pageMode;
77        return null;
78    }
79
80    private function processResultInPlayMode(int $tsumegoID, PlayOutcome $outcome, float $seconds, ?int $setConnectionID): array
81    {
82        $seconds = max(0.01, $seconds);
83        $solved = $outcome === PlayOutcome::SolvedClean || $outcome === PlayOutcome::SolvedAfterMistake;
84
85        $tsumego = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('Tsumego')->find()->where(['id' => $tsumegoID])->first();
86        if (!$tsumego)
87            return ['error' => 'Tsumego not found'];
88
89        if (Auth::isInTimeMode())
90        {
91            $timeMode = new TimeMode();
92            $playResult = ['solved' => $solved];
93            $timeMode->processPlayResult($tsumego, $playResult, $seconds, $outcome === PlayOutcome::TimedOut);
94        }
95
96        $result = [];
97        $result['solved'] = $solved;
98        $result['xp-modifier'] = 1;
99        $result['xp-gained'] = 0;
100
101        // updated isn't loaded: the database moves it when the status changes
102        $tsumegoStatus = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TsumegoStatus')->find()
103            ->select(['id', 'status'])
104            ->where(['tsumego_id' => $tsumegoID, 'user_id' => Auth::getUserID()])
105            ->first();
106
107        $previousStatusValue = $tsumegoStatus ? $tsumegoStatus->status : TsumegoStatusTable::$NOT_VISITED;
108        $this->processDamage($result, $previousStatusValue);
109        $newStatus = $this->updateTsumegoStatus($tsumego, $result, $tsumegoStatus);
110        if (TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($newStatus) && !TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($previousStatusValue))
111            SetCompletionCounter::updateAfterSolve((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
112
113        if (HeroPowers::getSprintRemainingSeconds() > 0)
114            $result['xp-modifier'] *= Constants::$SPRINT_MULTIPLIER;
115
116        $originalTsumegoRating = $tsumego->rating;
117
118        // the resets of the part of the set the problem is played from, in the last month
119        $progressDeletionCount = ProgressDeletionTable::countRecentForProblem(Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID, $setConnectionID);
120
121        $lastTsumegoAttempt = TsumegoAttemptTable::findLast((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
122
123        $this->processRatingChange($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue, $progressDeletionCount, TsumegoAttemptTable::failsInARow($lastTsumegoAttempt));
124        if (!$result['solved'])
125            $result['potion_triggered'] = $this->processPotion();
126        $this->processXpChange($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue, $originalTsumegoRating, $progressDeletionCount);
127        $this->updateTsumegoAttempt($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue, $seconds, $lastTsumegoAttempt);
128        ClassroomAssignmentTable::recordResult((int) Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID, $outcome);
129        // The pool is fed from every mode: a solved problem that goes wrong enters the
130        // review ladder, a clean solve climbs it. The training says it is the one playing, since a replay there counts for nothing,
131        // and so does the time mode, the one mode where a solved problem is not free play.
132        $trainingXp = null;
133        $review = MistakeTraining::recordResult(Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID, $outcome, $previousStatusValue, Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode(), Auth::isInTimeMode());
134        if ($review !== null && Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
135            $trainingXp = $this->processTrainingXp($review, (float) $originalTsumegoRating);
136        $this->processErrorAchievement($result, $previousStatusValue, $outcome);
137        $this->processUnsortedStuff($tsumego, $result, $previousStatusValue);
138        $this->processGoldenRun($result, $previousStatusValue);
139
140        // Check solve-dependent achievements right away (not only on the next page
141        // load) so the user sees the popup immediately after solving.
142        $achievementChecker = new AchievementChecker();
143        $achievementChecker->checkStandardAchievements()->finalize();
144
145        $response = [
146            'xp_gained' => $trainingXp !== null ? array_sum($trainingXp) : $result['xp-gained'],
147            'new_rating' => Auth::getUser()['rating'],
148            'new_xp' => Auth::getUser()['xp'],
149            'new_level' => Auth::getUser()['level'],
150            'new_damage' => Auth::getUser()['damage'],
151            'status' => $newStatus,
152            'potion_triggered' => $result['potion_triggered'] ?? false,
153        ];
154        if (!empty($achievementChecker->updated))
155            $response['achievement_updates'] = $achievementChecker->updated;
156        // The training row shows what today did with the problem, and this result just
157        // changed it, so the page redraws the button from the review as it was stored.
158        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
159        {
160            $response['mistake_training_button'] = MistakeTraining::describeTodaysReview(Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID);
161            $response['mistake_training_xp'] = $trainingXp ?? ['review' => 0, 'graduation' => 0, 'clear' => 0];
162        }
163
164        return $response;
165    }
166
167    //The XP of a review in the training (see MistakeTraining::REVIEW_XP_SHARE). It
168    //counts like the XP of a solve, for the level and the day's XP; the bonus for
169    //clearing the day is not a solve, so it leaves the day's solved count alone.
170    /**
171     * @param array{id: int, result: int, climbed: bool, clear_bonus: bool} $review
172     * @return array{review: int, graduation: int, clear: int}
173     */
174    private function processTrainingXp(array $review, float $problemRating): array
175    {
176        $xp = MistakeTraining::awardXp((int) Auth::getUserID(), $review, $problemRating);
177        if (array_sum($xp) == 0)
178            return $xp;
179
180        $user = & Auth::getUser();
181        if ($xp['review'] + $xp['graduation'] > 0)
182            Level::addXPAsResultOfTsumegoSolving($user, $xp['review'] + $xp['graduation']);
183        if ($xp['clear'] > 0)
184        {
185            Level::addXP($user, $xp['clear']);
186            $user['daily_xp'] += $xp['clear'];
187        }
188        Auth::saveUserFields([
189            'xp' => $user['xp'],
190            'level' => $user['level'],
191            'daily_xp' => $user['daily_xp'],
192            'daily_solved' => $user['daily_solved'],
193        ]);
194        return $xp;
195    }

206    //Potion: triggers after a fail when damage meets or exceeds max health.
207    public function processPotion(): bool
208    {
209        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
210            return false;
211        if (!HeroPowers::canPotionTrigger())
212            return false;
213
214        $excessDeaths = Auth::getUser()['damage'] - Util::getHealthBasedOnLevel(Auth::getUser()['level']);
215        $chance = min($excessDeaths * HeroPowers::$POTION_CHANCE_PER_DEATH, 100);
216
217        if (rand(1, 100) <= $chance)
218        {
219            Auth::saveUserFields([
220                'damage' => 0,
221                'used_potion' => 1,
222            ]);
223            return true;
224        }
225
226        AchievementConditionTable::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementConditionTable::CATEGORY_POTION);
227        return false;
228    }

230    private function getNewStatus(bool $solved, string $currentStatus, array &$result): string
231    {
232        if ($solved)
233        {
234            if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$REVIEW) // half xp state
235            {$result['xp-modifier'] *= Constants::$SECOND_SOLVE_XP_MULTIPLIER;
236                return TsumegoStatusTable::$MASTERED; // double solved
237            }
238            if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$GOLDEN)
239            {
240                $result['xp-modifier'] *= Constants::$GOLDEN_TSUMEGO_XP_MULTIPLIER;
241                return TsumegoStatusTable::$SOLVED;
242            }
243            if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$VISITED || $currentStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$NOT_VISITED)
244                return TsumegoStatusTable::$SOLVED;
245            return $currentStatus; // failed can't be unfailed by solving, user has to wait until next day or rejuvenation
246        }
247
248        // not solved from now
249        if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$VISITED) // if it was just visited so far (so we don't overwrite solved)
250        {if (Auth::getUser()['damage'] > Util::getHealthBasedOnLevel(Auth::getUser()['level']))
251            return TsumegoStatusTable::$LOCKED;  // only mark as failed when the user has no hearts left
252            return $currentStatus;
253        }
254        if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$REVIEW)
255        {
256            if (Auth::getUser()['damage'] > Util::getHealthBasedOnLevel(Auth::getUser()['level']))
257                return TsumegoStatusTable::$FORGOTTEN; // only mark as 'stale failed' when the user has no hearts left
258            return $currentStatus;
259        }
260        if ($currentStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$GOLDEN)
261            return TsumegoStatusTable::$VISITED; // failed golden tsumego
262        return $currentStatus;
263    }

265    private function updateTsumegoStatus(Tsumego $previousTsumego, array &$result, ?TsumegoStatus $previousTsumegoStatus): string
266    {
267        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
268            return $previousTsumegoStatus->status ?? TsumegoStatusTable::$NOT_VISITED;
269
270        $statusTable = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TsumegoStatus');
271        $previousTsumegoStatus ??= $statusTable->newEntity([
272            'user_id' => Auth::getUserID(),
273            'tsumego_id' => $previousTsumego->id,
274            'status' => TsumegoStatusTable::$VISITED]);
275
276        $newStatus = $this->getNewStatus($result['solved'], $previousTsumegoStatus->status, $result);
277
278        if (TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($newStatus) && !TsumegoUtil::isSolvedStatus($previousTsumegoStatus->status))
279            Auth::incrementUserField('solved', 1);
280        $previousTsumegoStatus->status = $newStatus;
281        $statusTable->saveOrFail($previousTsumegoStatus);
282        return $newStatus;
283    }

285    private function updateTsumegoAttempt(Tsumego $previousTsumego, array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, float $seconds, ?TsumegoAttempt $lastTsumegoAttempt): void
286    {
287        if (Auth::isInTimeMode() || Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
288            return;
289        if (TsumegoUtil::isRecentlySolved($previousTsumegoStatus))
290            return;
291
292        // only not solved ones are updated (misplays get accumulated)
293        $continued = $lastTsumegoAttempt && !$lastTsumegoAttempt->solved ? $lastTsumegoAttempt : null;
294        $values = [
295            Auth::getUser()['rating'],
296            $result['xp-gained'],
297            ($continued ? $continued->seconds : 0) + $seconds,
298            $result['solved'] ? 1 : 0,
299            $previousTsumego->rating,
300            ($continued ? $continued->misplays : 0) + ($result['solved'] ? 0 : 1),
301            date('Y-m-d H:i:s')];
302        // Plain SQL: the ratings and the seconds are floats that MySQL rounds into the integer columns,
303        // as it did for the Cake 2 save, where the ORM would cut off their fractions.
304        if ($continued)
305            Util::execute('UPDATE tsumego_attempt SET user_rating = ?, gain = ?, seconds = ?, solved = ?, tsumego_rating = ?, misplays = ?, created = ? WHERE id = ?',
306                [...$values, $continued->id]);
307        else
308            Util::execute('INSERT INTO tsumego_attempt (user_rating, gain, seconds, solved, tsumego_rating, misplays, created, user_id, tsumego_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
309                [...$values, Auth::getUserID(), $previousTsumego->id]);
310    }

312    private static function processRatingChangeStep(float &$userRating, float &$tsumegoRating, bool $isWin): void
313    {
314        $userRatingDelta = Rating::calculateRatingChange($userRating, $tsumegoRating, $isWin ? 1 : 0, Constants::$PLAYER_RATING_CALCULATION_MODIFIER);
315        $tsumegoRatingDelta = Rating::calculateRatingChange($tsumegoRating, $userRating, $isWin ? 0 : 1, Constants::$TSUMEGO_RATING_CALCULATION_MODIFIER);
316        $userRating += $userRatingDelta;
317        $tsumegoRating += $tsumegoRatingDelta;
318    }

320    private function processRatingChange(Tsumego $previousTsumego, array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, int $progressDeletionCount, int $failsInARow): void
321    {
322        if (!Auth::ratingisGainedInCurrentMode())
323            return;
324        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
325            return;
326
327        // After a reset of its part in the last month the problem is known, solving it again says little
328        // about the player or the problem, so neither rating changes.
329        if ($progressDeletionCount != 0)
330            return;
331
332        // Failing the same problem again and again tells nothing new about the player or the problem,
333        // so only the first fails in a row change the ratings, until the problem is solved.
334        if (!$result['solved'] && $failsInARow >= Constants::$MAXIMUM_RATED_FAILS_IN_A_ROW)
335            return;
336
337        $userRating = (float) Auth::getUser()['rating'];
338        $originalTsumegoRating = $previousTsumego->rating;
339        $tsumegoRating = $originalTsumegoRating;
340
341        // Each AJAX call is a single atomic event: fail or solve, never both.
342        // Prior misplays were already processed by their own AJAX calls.
343        self::processRatingChangeStep($userRating, $tsumegoRating, $result['solved']);
344
345        Auth::saveUserFields([
346            'rating' => $userRating,
347            'highest_rating' => max((float) Auth::getUser()['highest_rating'], $userRating)]);
348
349        $previousTsumego->rating = Util::clampOptional(
350            $tsumegoRating,
351            $previousTsumego->minimum_rating,
352            $previousTsumego->maximum_rating);
353        TsumegoTable::addToRating($previousTsumego->id, $tsumegoRating - $originalTsumegoRating);
354    }

367    private function processXpChange(Tsumego $previousTsumego, array &$result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, int|float|string $originalTsumegoRating, int $progressDeletionCount): void
368    {
369        if (!Auth::XPisGainedInCurrentMode())
370            return;
371        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
372            return;
373        if (!$result['solved'])
374            return;
375
376        $multiplier = $result['xp-modifier'];
377        if ($previousTsumegoStatus != TsumegoStatusTable::$GOLDEN)
378            $multiplier *= TsumegoXPAndRating::getProgressDeletionMultiplier($progressDeletionCount);
379
380        $user = & Auth::getUser();
381        $result['xp-gained'] = Rating::ratingToXP($originalTsumegoRating, $multiplier);
382        Level::addXPAsResultOfTsumegoSolving($user, $result['xp-gained']);
383        Auth::saveUserFields([
384            'xp' => $user['xp'],
385            'level' => $user['level'],
386            'daily_xp' => $user['daily_xp'],
387            'daily_solved' => $user['daily_solved'],
388        ]);
389    }

391    private function processErrorAchievement(array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus, PlayOutcome $outcome): void
392    {
393        if (!Auth::XPisGainedInCurrentMode())
394            return;
395        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
396            return;
397
398        // The streak counts the problems solved since the last error: only a clean solve
399        // extends it, anything else resets it.
400        if ($outcome === PlayOutcome::SolvedClean)
401            AchievementConditionTable::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementConditionTable::CATEGORY_NO_ERROR_STREAK);
402        else
403            AchievementConditionTable::put(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementConditionTable::CATEGORY_NO_ERROR_STREAK, 0);
404    }

406    private function processUnsortedStuff(Tsumego $previousTsumego, array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus): void
407    {
408        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
409            return;
410        if (!Level::XPAndRatingIsGainedInTsumegoStatus($previousTsumegoStatus))
411            return;
412        if (!$result['solved'])
413            return;
414
415        $solvedTsumegoRank = Rating::getReadableRankFromRating($previousTsumego->rating);
416        if (isset(AchievementConditionTable::DAN_SOLVE_CATEGORIES[$solvedTsumegoRank]))
417            AchievementConditionTable::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementConditionTable::DAN_SOLVE_CATEGORIES[$solvedTsumegoRank]);
418        DayRecordTable::countGemSolve($solvedTsumegoRank);
419        //The sprint run counts the problems solved in a row while a sprint is active (user.sprint_start)
420        if (HeroPowers::getSprintRemainingSeconds() > 0)
421            AchievementConditionTable::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementConditionTable::CATEGORY_SPRINT);
422        else
423            AchievementConditionTable::put(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementConditionTable::CATEGORY_SPRINT, 0);
424    }
425
426    //The Gold Digger run counts the golden tsumego solved in a row. A golden tsumego is a
427    //single attempt, so a solve moves the run one further and a fail starts it over.
428    private function processGoldenRun(array $result, string $previousTsumegoStatus): void
429    {
430        if (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
431            return;
432        if ($previousTsumegoStatus != TsumegoStatusTable::$GOLDEN)
433            return;
434        if ($result['solved'])
435            AchievementConditionTable::increment(Auth::getUserID(), AchievementConditionTable::CATEGORY_GOLDEN);
436        else

438    }
